description: Hivekit is a commercial operations platform for mines that combines real-time visibility of equipment and people, AI-assisted planning and short-interval control, shown through a real-time digital twin of the operation from mine to mill. For surface and open-pit mines it tracks loading, hauling, dumping and drilling with cycle times, delays and queues linked to the mine plan; for underground mines it plans drill, load, blast and muck cycles with 3D views of vehicles, workers, material and ventilation in low-connectivity settings; and for haulage it optimises routes, allocates drivers and vehicles and schedules maintenance, with alerting for mill and plant processing. It is made by Hivekit Inc. Coverage is generic, for mines anywhere, and the same geospatial base serves construction, fleet, field service and emergency dispatch uses. Access is commercial through demos booked on the site; developers can use an HTTP API, a JavaScript SDK, a rules language and real-time feeds with geofencing, and some code is on GitHub. Caveats: the page is marketing material with no prices, deployment details or customer evidence. For simulation it provides live fleet and production data and a platform for digital twins of mine logistics, useful in capacity planning and in studying how haul road, power or ventilation disruptions ripple through production. It is related to the Deswik record in this catalogue, a mine planning suite.
